sources.name: Energy-Storage.News
sources.why: Dedicated global coverage of grid-scale battery and long-duration energy storage projects, project finance, deployments and storage economics. Correct hyphenated domain with a verified /feed.

sources.name: Modo Energy
sources.why: Industry-leading battery/grid data analytics platform; benchmark revenue, sizing and deployment analytics for UK batteries. Bot-protected, crawl via their public content feed or podcast endpoint.

sources.name: Eigen Values (David Turver)
sources.why: Independent engineer analysing grid expansion, connection queues, and network bottlenecks for renewables in the UK.

sources.name: Grid Capacity Intelligence
sources.why: Specialist newsletter on GB grid connection capacity, network constraints and available capacity data.

sources.name: Elexon
sources.why: Balancing mechanism reporting service operator; publishes imbalance prices, BM data and market operational insight.

sources.name: NESO (National Energy System Operator)
sources.why: GB system operator; publishes whole-systems data covering both transmission network constraints and distribution-level demand/connection data via its Data Portal, plus constraint reports, interconnector flows and balancing data. Verified public RSS feed at /rss.xml.

sources.name: Energy Monitor
sources.why: Covers interconnectors, market integration and European power trading developments.

sources.name: Current News
sources.why: Dedicated UK energy policy news covering CfD Allocation Rounds, capacity market auctions, and DESNZ policy announcements.

sources.name: Electrical News
sources.why: UK energy sector trade news with strong coverage of CfD and capacity market outcomes and government energy policy.

sources.name: GridBeyond
sources.why: Demand-side flexibility and grid balancing technology provider publishing market analytics on flexibility markets.

sources.name: Clean Energy Pipeline
sources.why: Global clean energy deal tracking including nuclear new-build financing, SMR funding rounds and project pipelines.

sources.name: Oxera
sources.why: Economic consultancy publishing rigorous analysis of RAB funding models, nuclear CfDs and network price controls.

subareas.name: Storage beyond lithium-ion (CAES, thermal, gravity, flow)

sources.name: LDES Council
sources.why: The Long Duration Energy Storage Council — the dedicated global body for LDES (CAES, thermal, gravity, flow) covering member deployments, emerging-technology announcements, hyperscale data-centre load and EU/GB LDES policy support. Verified RSS feed. Replaces the generic renewables source for this subarea.

sources.name: WindEurope
sources.why: European wind industry body publishing offshore wind market data, auction results and policy analysis.

sources.name: offshoreWIND.biz
sources.why: Dedicated global offshore wind trade publication covering project milestones, CfD/auction round outcomes, vessel and turbine supply-chain economics and transmission/farm build-out news. Verified RSS feed. Replaces the generic renewables source for this subarea.

sources.name: Energy-Stats UK
sources.why: UK electricity statistics and carbon intensity data feed with daily generation and emissions tracking.

sources.name: Ofgem
sources.why: UK energy regulator publishing price control determinations, RIIO network settlements and retail price cap decisions.

notes: Modo Energy and National Grid ESO are core to the topic but are bot-protected; crawler should target their public data endpoints and podcast feed URLs rather than homepage. current-news.co.uk serves its feed via evinfrastructurenews.com/rss.xml. Elexon BMRS API is the definitive structured source for balancing data. LCCC uses lccc.org.uk (lccc.uk fails DNS). DESNZ content is accessible via gov.uk rather than desnz.gov.uk which fails DNS.
